in_hebrew.name: Azalee
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is my helper
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Azalee הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew 'Azal' meaning 'helping, exalted, hasty'. In the Bible, Azalea is a variant of the Hebrew name 'Azalel', which is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of an angel in the Tabernacle. Azalee thus symbolizes divine assistance, protection, and quickness.
